# MERV doctor setup (automated)

Each JS package ships a **`doctor setup`** CLI that scaffolds or **heals** MERV wiring in an existing project.

Doctor **only** touches MERV-related pieces: missing `merv.*` keys, reporter/formatter entries, bridge/jsconfig remaps, sample scripts. Unrelated project settings are left alone.

---

## What `merv.properties` keys doctor ensures

Doctor creates the file when missing, or **appends only missing keys** (never overwrites your values):

| Key | Default when added | Notes |
|-----|--------------------|-------|
| `merv.local` | `true` | Local on-disk reports |
| `merv.report.folder` | `./merv-reports/` | Report root |
| `merv.regression_suite` | from `--suite-title` or project name | Suite title |
| `merv.screenshot` | `false` | Step screenshots |
| `merv.emailable.html` | `false` | Set `true` to write interactive `emailable-report.html` on every suite finish |

Share / Download on the suite report need a running report server (`npx merv show-report`). Use `--host 0.0.0.0` for LAN Share. Full guide: [Share, Download & emailable](https://merv.online/merv-local-share-download.html) (or `merv-ui/public/website/merv-local-share-download.html` in this monorepo).

---

## Commands

| Project type | Command |
|--------------|---------|
| **Custom report** (`MervReport`) | `npm i -D merv-client` → `npx merv-client doctor setup` |
| **Playwright Test** | `npm i -D merv-client-playwright` → `npx merv-client-playwright doctor setup` |
| **Cucumber-js** | `npm i -D merv-client-cucumber` → `npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup` |

### Common options

| Flag | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `--typescript` / `--javascript` | Prefer TS or JS artifacts (auto-detected when omitted) |
| `--force` | Overwrite doctor-generated demo files where applicable |
| `--suite-title <name>` | Suite title for new / missing `merv.regression_suite` |
| `-h` / `--help` | Show CLI help |

Examples:

```bash
npx merv-client doctor setup
npx merv-client doctor setup --typescript --suite-title "API Suite"

npx merv-client-playwright doctor setup
npx merv-client-playwright doctor setup --typescript

npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup
npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup --typescript --force
```

---

## What each doctor does

### `merv-client doctor setup` (core / custom)

- Creates or fills missing keys in **`merv.properties`**
- Adds sample **`scripts/custom-report.*`** when missing
- Merges MERV-safe **jsconfig/tsconfig** bits
- Adds npm scripts (e.g. `show-report`) when missing

Does **not** configure Playwright or Cucumber adapters.

### `merv-client doctor setup-log` (Merv-Logs only)

- Creates or fills **`merv.properties`** (including `merv.logger.file` / `merv.logger.level`)
- Adds **`show-logs`** and **`show-report`** scripts when missing
- Adds **`merv-client`** dependency when missing

Does **not** create `jsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.json`, or `scripts/custom-report.*`.

```bash
npx merv-client doctor setup-log
npm install   # if doctor added merv-client
npx merv show-logs
```

### `merv-client doctor set console` / `unset console`

Rewrites source files that call `console.log` / `info` / `warn` / `error` / `debug` / `trace`:

```bash
# Add (or toggle off) doctor-managed imports
npx merv-client doctor set console

# Remove only lines marked // merv-doctor-console
npx merv-client doctor unset console
```

- **ESM** (`"type":"module"`, `.mjs`, or files that already `import`):  
  `import { console } from 'merv-client'; // merv-doctor-console`  
  In **Vite / React** projects (`.jsx`, `.tsx`, or files using `import.meta`), doctor uses  
  `import { console } from 'merv-client/browser'; // merv-doctor-console` instead.
- **CommonJS**:  
  `const { console } = require('merv-client'); // merv-doctor-console`
- Skips `node_modules`, `dist`, `merv-reports`, etc.
- **`set`** toggles: if a doctor import is already present, it is removed; otherwise it is added when the file uses `console.*`
- **`unset`** only removes doctor-managed imports (manual `merv-client` console imports are left alone)

### `merv-client-playwright doctor setup`

- Same **`merv.properties`** heal/merge
- Creates / corrects the **test bridge** when needed
- Merges **jsconfig/tsconfig** safely (does **not** remap `@playwright/test` via `package.json` `imports` for config)
- Adds **`merv-client-playwright/reporter`** to `playwright.config` without wiping other options
- Removes bad `@playwright/test` → bridge remaps if present

### `merv-client-cucumber doctor setup`

- Same **`merv.properties`** heal/merge
- Creates **`cucumber.js`** or adds **`merv-client-cucumber`** formatter only
- Migrates legacy `merv-client/cucumber-formatter` → `merv-client-cucumber`
- Adds `require` globs only when missing
- Adds `show-report` / `test:cucumber` scripts when missing
- Scaffolds demo `features/` only when no `.feature` files exist

---

## After setup

```bash
# Playwright
npx playwright test
npx merv show-report

# Cucumber
npx cucumber-js
npx merv show-report

# Custom
node scripts/custom-report.mjs   # or path doctor created
npx merv show-report
```

### Open the Merv report (all commands)

Run from the project root (folder with `merv.properties`):

```bash
npx merv show-report
npx merv show-logs                  # opens Merv-Logs directly
npx merv-client show-report
npm run show-report                 # if doctor added the script
npm run show-logs                   # if doctor added the script

# Explicit report folder
npx merv show-report ./merv-reports
npx merv show-report /absolute/path/to/merv-reports

# Options
npx merv show-report --port 6174
npx merv show-report --host 127.0.0.1
npx merv show-report --host 0.0.0.0   # LAN Share (firewall must allow the port)
npx merv show-report --no-open
npx merv show-report ./merv-reports --port 8080 --no-open
npx merv show-logs --host 0.0.0.0
```

Serves `{merv.report.folder}` on **http://127.0.0.1:6174/** (opens the browser by default). `show-logs` opens `/merv-logs.html` instead of the dashboard. With `--host 0.0.0.0`, colleagues on the same network can open suite reports via Share.

Optional: set `merv.emailable.html=true` so each suite finish writes `emailable-report.html` (Download always regenerates it anyway).

| URL | Page |
|-----|------|
| `http://127.0.0.1:6174/` | Dashboard (`index.html`) |
| `http://127.0.0.1:6174/merv-logs.html` | Merv-Logs live console |

Stop with Ctrl+C. Prefer this over `file://` or Live Server when you need delete APIs or Merv-Logs paging.

---

## Prefer manual setup?

Every guide still documents **manual** wiring (`merv.properties`, reporter/formatter, bridge). Use doctor when you want a fast, safe heal; use manual steps when you want full control of every file.

- Playwright: [merv-client-playwright README](../../merv-client-playwright/README.md)
- Cucumber: [merv-client-cucumber README](../../merv-client-cucumber/README.md)
- Custom: [CUSTOM_REPORT.md](./CUSTOM_REPORT.md)
- Deep Playwright wiring: [FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md](../FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md)
